title: Adaptive list/preview pane split based on terminal width
source: exploration plan §9: make list primary, use adaptive thresholds, narrow terminals show full-width list
why_chosen: Directly addresses the hard-coded 40/60 split that wastes list space on wide terminals. Low-risk since it only changes the layout constraint numbers.
before: Fixed 40/60 split at all terminal sizes. On a 160-col terminal the list got 64 cols and the preview got 96 cols, making session titles hard to read at 54-char truncation.
after: Adaptive split: ≥120 cols → 55/45 (list-primary), ≥100 → 50/50, ≥80 → 45/55, <80 → 60/40. The list gets proportionally more space on wider terminals while the preview remains usable.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds.
open_questions: Narrow-terminal toggle (full-width list, no preview) requires a new interaction mode - deferred to future iteration
